findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote · Private data: get_networks, find_token, check_token, get_api_info, get_quote, create_deposit_swap, get_deposit_status, get_earnings, get_signing_guide, get_trade_status · Public sink: get_networks, create_deposit_swap, get_trade_status · Destructive: find_token.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote · Private data: get_networks, find_token, check_token, get_api_info, get_quote, create_deposit_swap, get_deposit_status, get_earnings, get_signing_guide, get_trade_status · Public sink: get_networks, create_deposit_swap, get_trade_status · Destructive: find_token

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
